summary: American radio host Laura Schlessinger parlayed a physiology PhD and a start on Bill Ballance's 1970s Los Angeles show into a hugely popular call-in advice program that berated callers, mostly women, until a 2010 racial slur tirade.
keywords: Ten Stupid Things Women Do to Mess Up Their Lives
The Proper Care and Feeding of Husbands

evidence.note: born January 1947 in Brooklyn, raised on Long Island
moves to Los Angeles to teach at USC; career thereafter centred on LA radio
long segment on Bill Ballance, his Feminine Forum show and influence on talk radio
first calls into Ballance's show in 1975, start of her radio career
non-clinical PhD used to present herself as a doctor and therapist on air
tells working mothers to quit careers while she kept working herself
feud with rival Barbara De Angelis over credentials at KFI, anonymous complaints
mid-1990s rise framed within conservative grievance and culture-war media
book and modern videos telling wives never to refuse sex; calls women pigs
2001 remarks calling homosexuality a biological error and the backlash
2010 broadcast clip with repeated racial slur played; leads to her leaving the show

notes: Subject still active at release, so main_span end is null; main_span starts with her 1975 entry into radio. Transcript calls her doctorate kinesiology; it is generally given as physiology (Columbia, 1974). Host also slips once and names the first book as about men. misogyny-manosphere is an imperfect fit for her anti-feminist advice; no theme for advice/talk-show culture beyond propaganda-media and wellness-self-help.
